notifications.name: Magnetic – Magnetic Construction Toy
notifications.danger: The toy is made of small parts with a high magnetic flux. A child may put them in the mouth, which may lead to choking, or if swallowed, they could attract one another, causing intestinal blockage or perforation. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive nor with the European standard EN 71-1.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator to whom the measure(s) were ordered: RetailerCategory of measure(s): Stop of salesDate of entry into force: 13/05/2024
notifications.description: Sets of magnetic building components.

notifications.name: Electric Gun
notifications.danger: The electronic components of the product have an excessive concentration of lead (Pb) (measured value up to 73% by weight) and cadmium (measured value up to 2.89%). Lead and cadmium pose a risk to the environment. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Directive on the restriction of the use of certain hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment (RoHS 2 Directive).
